sources.title: Clique partitions and bounded simplicial defect
sources.author: Obinna Okechukwu
sources.inspection: Full manuscript read for scope. Every main proof step in Sections 1-5 checked; equation and overbar layout checked on rendered pages including 2, 8-11, 18-20. Section 6 is not accepted by this audit.
sources.source_status: arXiv preprint, v1; journal acceptance, external referee acceptance, and formal certification not verified

sources.title: Integer and fractional packing of families of graphs
sources.author: Raphael Yuster
sources.inspection: Definitions and Theorems 1.1-1.2, explicit quantification at start of Section 3, and subgraph construction / concluding packing argument on PDF pages 3-7 checked. Disconnected templates, non-induced copies and no-isolated-vertices conventions verified. Established theorem accepted; regularity and hypergraph-matching foundations not re-proved.

sources.title: The List Chromatic Index of a Bipartite Multigraph
sources.author: Fred Galvin
sources.inspection: Original article downloaded. Printed pp153-155 read using local OCR, and pp156-157 visually inspected. Theorem 4.1 and its kernel/list-coloring prerequisites match the exact application to a complete bipartite graph with an explicit a-edge-coloring.

sources.title: On rigid circuit graphs
sources.author: G. A. Dirac
sources.inspection: Publisher metadata verified. Full original paper unavailable through the inspected publisher route. The required simplicial-pair lemma and rooted chordal equivalence are proved independently in the authored integral audit, so this access limitation leaves no missing mathematical step.

sources.inspection: Journal metadata and abstract verified. Original journal full text not retrieved; original graph conventions and conjectures were checked in the primary reprint listed separately.

sources.title: Clique Partitions of Chordal Graphs, reprinted in Combinatorics, Geometry and Probability
sources.inspection: Primary chapter identity confirmed with publisher. Full chapter text available in public scan; inspected printed pp291-295, especially graph conventions pp291-292 and Conjectures 1-2 on p294. Conjecture 1 explicitly permits a linear additive term. Conjecture 2 is the stronger all-order exact question.
